Australian officials propose restricting parliamentary clip sharing

Australia's top bureaucrats, represented by the Secretaries Board, have proposed restricting the sharing of video clips from parliamentary proceedings on social media. The board expressed concern that material is often posted without proper context, leading to ridicule. This proposal has drawn criticism from some senators, who have labelled it 'outrageous'. The Greens have warned that such a ban could lead to a lack of transparency.
